_doc: Which wago.tools builds are World of Warcraft: Forever. `pipeline client-check` picks the newest build whose product is listed in `products` OR whose version is 1.x at or above `min_version`, so a product key that moves (wow_classic_beta -> wow_cn_beta in October 2026) or a renumbering at launch is still found. Products in `ignore_products` are never Forever, whatever their version. A build newer than the active one that matches neither rule is reported as a warning, never activated.
